propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks large bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) unless they carry an attestation signed by the pinned prod op-cert environment, which has no accessible client in the repo and no mechanism to record returned envelopes.
An unpinned developer environment signing a plan-review attestation causes the gate to return verdict='mismatch' and blocks the change, even when the plan review passed and is genuinely signed.

The only way to satisfy the gate for a contributor is to have their environment pinned in .rebar/trusted_environments.yaml, which is CODEOWNERS-gated and requires an admin round-trip, making the criterion unsatisfiable in practice for any contributor.

The fix removes the source-of-certification chain (trusted_env_keyring lookup and verify_opcert call) and gates only on the fact of a completed, subject-bound, lifecycle-valid attestation, treating it as an anti-sloppiness check rather than anti-adversary.
Subject binding (ticket id and kind verification) is re-asserted explicitly in the classifier after verify_opcert deletion to prevent cross-ticket attestation replay.
